project(lab_third_party)

set(THRID_PARTY_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../..")

set(BORINGSSL_DIR "${THRID_PARTY_DIR}/boringssl/boringssl")

set(CURL_USE_LIBPSL OFF)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF)
set(BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF)
set(CURL_DISABLE_INSTALL ON)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(BUILD_STATIC_LIBS ON)
set(BUILD_STATIC_CURL ON)
set(CURL_ENABLE_EXPORT_TARGET OFF)
set(ENABLE_CURL_MANUAL OFF)
set(BUILD_LIBCURL_DOCS OFF)
set(PERL_EXECUTABLE OFF)
set(CURL_ENABLE_SSL ON)

if(WIN32)
    if(CURL_USE_BORINGSSL AND EXISTS "${BORINGSSL_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
        set(OPENSSL_NO_ASM ON)
        add_subdirectory("${BORINGSSL_DIR}" boringssl_wrapper)
        set_target_properties(boringssl_prefix_symbols PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/boringssl")
        set_target_properties(bssl PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/boringssl")
        set_target_properties(crypto PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/boringssl")
        set_target_properties(decrepit PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/boringssl")
        set_target_properties(fipsmodule PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/boringssl")
        set_target_properties(pki PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/boringssl")
        set_target_properties(ssl PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/boringssl")
    else()
        set(CURL_USE_BORINGSSL OFF)
        set(CURL_USE_SCHANNEL ON)
    endif()
endif()

set(CURL_REPO_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../..")
add_subdirectory("${CURL_REPO_DIR}" curl_wrapper)

set_target_properties(curl PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/curl")
set_target_properties(curlinfo PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/curl")
set_target_properties(curltool PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/curl")
set_target_properties(libcurl_object PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/curl")
set_target_properties(libcurl_static PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party/curl")
